observations: Orange gas cylinder with two top handles.
Red diamond-shaped hazard label on the top.
The cylinder is wrapped in a hexagonal wire mesh.
A handwritten 'A3' is visible on the side of the cylinder.
The cylinder is sitting on a metal shelf in what appears to be a shop or warehouse.
A watermark 'DANIEL DIBO POSTED ON JIJI' is present on both photos.

claims.evidence: The brand 'Tokunbo' is clearly printed on the label in both photos.

claims.claim: Recently tested and certified, no leak, the valve is new.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The cylinder may be expired or past its re-test date.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacture or expiry date stamped on the handle or base.

risks.risk: The valve may be faulty or leaking.
risks.proof: A video showing a soap bubble test on the valve while the cylinder is held under water.

risks.risk: The cylinder may be empty or contain a different gas than butane.
risks.proof: A photo of the weight stamp on the handle or base.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the manufacture or expiry date stamped on the handle or base.
Photo of the weight stamp on the handle or base.
Video of the valve being tested for leaks.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
